title: Mammalian Cell Culture: Subculturing
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xukfnuw

steps.title: Assess Cell Confluency
steps.instruction: Evaluate the percentage of surface covered by cells using a light microscope to determine if subculturing is necessary.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells in the T-25 flask twice using DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL DPBS to the T-25 flask using a serological pipette.
Remove DPBS and dispose of it into a waste beaker.
Repeat these two actions a second time.

steps.title: Detach Cells with Trypsin-EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of warmed trypsin-EDTA to the T-25 flask and wait 5 minutes for cells to detach.

substeps.instruction: Monitor detachment progress using a light microscope if necessary, as some cell types may take up to 15 minutes depending on trypsin concentration (e.g., 0.05% vs 0.25%).

steps.title: Neutralize Trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of cell culture media to the flask to neutralize the trypsin-EDTA.

steps.title: Collect and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a centrifuge tube and spin down to form a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension (cells, trypsin-EDTA, and media) into a 15 mL centrifuge tube using a serological pipette.
Centrifuge the suspension at 1.5 kRPM for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from the centrifuge tube without disturbing the cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove the bulk of the supernatant using a serological pipette and dispose of it in a waste beaker.
Carefully remove the remaining supernatant using a 1000 μL pipette.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in cell culture media.

substeps.instruction: Add 1000 µL cell culture media to the cell pellet and let sit for 1 minute.
Gently pipette mix the pellet by slowly drawing in and pushing out the solution several times without removing the tip from the liquid.

steps.title: Prepare Flask for Reseeding
steps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL of fresh cell culture media to the T-25 flask to preserve any remaining cells.

steps.title: Reseed Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the cell suspension into the T-25 flask.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the flask at 37 °C in a CO2 incubator.
